name: AIGVE-Bench
description:
AIGVE-Bench: A Multifaceted Benchmark for AI-Generated Video Evaluation
	

AIGVE-Bench is a large-scale, human-annotated benchmark designed to evaluate AI-generated video content across nine critical dimensions. It is introduced in the paper AIGVE-Tool: AI-Generated Video Evaluation Toolkit
with Multifaceted Benchmark, a modular and extensible evaluation toolkit. Together, they establish a unified infrastructure for rigorous, reproducible, and multi-perspective assessment of video… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/xiaoliux/AIGVE-Bench.
evaluation_method: human_eval (dimension-wise human ratings) with optional automatic metric comparisons
general_score_metric: dimension-wise human-rated scores and optional composite quality score
reputation: A large, carefully annotated resource for AI-generated video evaluation that is gaining attention among multimedia and generative video researchers but is not yet ubiquitous.
